## Project
Tasks API — a small Flask service for creating and tracking tasks.

## Structure
- `app/__init__.py` — Flask app factory, registers the `tasks` blueprint.
- `app/routes.py` — all HTTP routes live here. This is the file most PRs
  will touch.
- `app/db.py` — in-memory data store standing in for a real database.
  Swap this out first if you ever add persistence.
- `tests/test_tasks.py` — the full test suite, one file, unittest-based.
- `run.py` — entrypoint (`python run.py`).

## Conventions
- Every route handler returns a Flask `jsonify(...)` response.
- The public response shape for a task is defined once, in `_serialize()`
  in `routes.py` — never build a task dict by hand elsewhere.
- Tests use `db.reset()` in `setUp()` to isolate state between tests.

## Where things live
| If you need to... | Look in |
|---|---|
| Add or change an endpoint | `app/routes.py` |
| Change how tasks are stored | `app/db.py` |
| Add a test | `tests/test_tasks.py` |
| Document a new env var | `.env.example` and `README.md` |
| Record a behavior change | `CHANGELOG.md` |

## Known risk areas
- `app/routes.py` is the highest-churn file in the repo — most bugs and
  breaking changes originate here. Review changes to `_serialize()`
  especially carefully since it defines the public API contract.
